name: NAVER Cloud Server
line: Run virtual servers on NAVER Cloud and manage their operating systems.

free.text: 1 Micro Server for Korea residents; 1 year, IP/traffic extra; then paid

cells.regions: KR/US West/SG/JP/DE; g3 VPC only KR/SG/JP

work.math: ₩26,000 for the server + ₩4,032 for the IP address + (100 minus 20) GB × ₩100 = ₩38,032 a month before VAT. The 50 GB boot disk is included.
₩26,000 for the server + ₩4,032 for the IP address + 80 GB × ₩100 = ₩38,032 a month before VAT. 1 vCPU and 2 GB meets the minimum, but throughput is not verified.
₩85,120 + ₩4,032 for the IP address + ₩8,000 for data sent out + ₩30,000 minimum for backup = ₩127,152 a month subtotal. Stored backup may exceed 100 GB.
